locations.label: Truck equipment route
locations.description: The central truck can be opened for 3,000. Inside are the AK74u, Semtex, Claymores and Bowie Knife. Break the boxes with melee attacks to expose the Galvaknuckles purchase. This is an optional expensive detour, so secure a safe route and core perks before buying everything at once. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.
